name: mstack-claude-review-workflow
description: Codex-led coordinator workflow for any task in a repository, from a list of issues (GitHub or another tracker), an execution plan, or one larger task. Codex leads and implements in conflict-free lanes (parallel codex exec lanes in git worktrees, or one agent in sequence), tracks each item as open, in progress or closed, has Claude review every lane read-only through the agent-bridges claude-review skill, integrates, and delivers one pull request with CI run one at a time. Codex only.

interface.shortDescription: Deliver issues, a plan or a task with Codex lanes and Claude review.
interface.longDescription: Codex coordinates and implements: it reads the work items, splits them into lanes with exclusive files, runs each lane as a codex exec process in its own git worktree, and has Claude Code review every lane read-only through the claude-review skill. It keeps an Open, In progress, Closed status table, integrates the accepted lanes, and ships one pull request with serialized CI. Requires the claude plugin from mubeda/agent-bridges (its claude-review skill), node, and a logged-in claude CLI.
